claims.claim: Treats a path as an automatic-trigger candidate only when at least one changed path is not Markdown.
Records candidate paths from tool calls but promotes them only after matching successful tool results.
Uses Git ignore checks for in-worktree paths and drops uncertain in-worktree candidates when repository or ignore detection fails unexpectedly.
Collects dirty Jujutsu paths when a Jujutsu working copy is present, otherwise combines changed and untracked Git paths.
Applies disabled or confirm-first mode before scheduling a plain-language follow-up after Pi becomes idle.
Registers the simplify-code command, including a manual working-copy pass and scoped mode configuration.
Runs from agent_end while suppressing pending-user-message and self-trigger loops.
